consumer: An engine eligibility/condition check asking "does the avatar possess a working multitool?" answered by the Character possession-count predicate, not a re-scan of the export JSON.
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person possession), with functional-tool semantics (pseudo/charges)
decisive_source: src/visitable.cpp::visitable<Character>::amount_of — special-cases bionic pseudo-tools then tallies the itype via amount_of_internal, returning the engine-computed count the check consumes; write_carried_items only emits a display array and is not the authority.
divergence: A multitool nested inside a gun or magazine: visit_internal (Excerpt 3) refuses to descend into gun/magazine contents so the engine predicate returns 0/no, while a naive scan of carried_items[] would report yes — exposing the re-derivation as wrong.
